usageNotes: Use this to check pending package updates on a PVE remote without triggering a live refresh — PDM returns its cached snapshot, so results reflect the last time the remote synced update metadata. The caller needs Resource.Audit on the remote resource; no query parameters are accepted. If the cache is stale, trigger a refresh via the corresponding update-fetch operation before calling this endpoint.

examples.summary: Get cached update list for a PVE remote named 'pve-hetzner'

tips: The response reflects cached data — it does not poll the remote live. Schedule or manually trigger a cache refresh if up-to-date package counts are needed.
The remote name must be 2–32 characters and match the pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ — alphanumeric/underscore start, dots and hyphens allowed after.
API tokens are accepted (allowtoken: true); no special protected-resource flag means standard PDM token scopes apply.
